description:
Reorganize the 'ShopManager' Java project into a proper package hierarchy using Eclipse's Refactor > Move feature.

Currently, all classes are dumped into a single flat package: 'myapp'. You need to move them into domain-specific packages to improve the architecture.

Goal Structure:
- com.myapp.model: User, Product, Order
- com.myapp.service: UserService, ProductService, OrderService
- com.myapp.util: StringUtils, DateUtils
- com.myapp.config: AppConfig
- com.myapp: App (keep main class here)

Instructions:
1. Open the ShopManager project in Eclipse.
2. Create the new packages listed above.
3. Use Refactor > Move (Alt+Shift+V) to move the classes to their new packages. DO NOT simply move files in the file system; you must use Eclipse refactoring to update imports automatically.
4. Ensure the project compiles with zero errors after restructuring.
5. Delete the empty 'myapp' package when done.
